data.rationale: routein_finalize iterates i<ctx->max_sess and reads ctx->http_repair_sessions[i].dld (line 92) without checking that http_repair_sessions is non-NULL. The array is only allocated in routein_initialize (lines 692-694), and only on the code path that reaches the repair-session setup; on early failure (e.g. a malformed mabr:// URL missing a port, which makes the DVB-MABR/routein filter fail setup with Bad Parameter before allocation) the array stays NULL. gf_filter_setup_failure_task still invokes the finalize callback on the failed filter, so line 92 dereferences NULL and crashes. Reproduced under the fuzz target fuzz_probe_analyze with the input "mabr://\x04": ASan reports SEGV at 0x0 pc in routein_finalize /src/gpac/src/filters/in_route.c:92:36, stack gf_filter_setup_failure_task <- gf_fs_thread_proc <- gf_fs_run <- LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput. Fix would be to guard the loop/free with a NULL check on http_repair_sessions (or force max_sess=0 until allocation).
